name: openforms
description: A self-hosted form backend for Cloudflare Workers and D1

scripts.check: npm run check:config && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build: npm run check:config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.deploy: npm run check:config && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Private form submissions and durable email outbox. Created in your account.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Your Resend sending API key for your verified domain.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for your Turnstile widget; configure your website's hostname.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random bearer token of at least 32 characters for private submission access.

ABUSE_SECRET.description: Random secret of at least 32 characters for temporary abuse-control hashes.
